title: Leo the Lion and the Secret King

narrations.title: The Royal Decree
narrations.narration: Leo the Lion marched through the jungle with high knees and a rhythmic bounce. He loved being in charge.

narrations.title: The Shivering Ensemble
narrations.narration: The Forest Animals huddled together in their colorful knitted scarves, shivering in unison.

narrations.title: Robby's Mischievous Plan
narrations.narration: Robby the Rabbit checked his golden pocket watch. He had a playful smirk on his face; he loved a good prank, and Leo was the perfect target.

narrations.title: The News of a Rival
narrations.narration: Robby hopped in quick bursts of speed toward Leo, delivering some 'terrible' news.

narrations.title: The Clumsy March
narrations.narration: Leo couldn't stand the idea of a rival. He marched toward the well, though he accidentally stumbled over his own paws along the way.

narrations.title: The Mirror Image
narrations.narration: Leo leaned over the edge. He looked down into the still water and saw a lion with a purple cape and a tilted crown.

narrations.title: The Great Splash
narrations.narration: Leo took a deep breath to roar, but his voice cracked into a high-pitched squeak. In a fury, he jumped into the well with a giant splash!

narrations.title: The Soggy Sponge
narrations.narration: Leo climbed out soaking wet, looking like a giant, soggy golden sponge. His crown was crooked and his cape was dripping.

narrations.title: A Kinder King
narrations.narration: Leo realized he had been tricked. He decided that instead of making silly rules, he would spend more time playing with his friends.
